# Glance Studio — Public Documentation & Technical Reference

> Scripted 1080x1920 30fps vertical chat-story video renderer for iPhone, iPad, and Mac staging flat or 3D RealityKit iPhone scenes with cached on-device Hugging Face Maya1 neural voiceover and zero export watermark.

## Publisher & Entity Provenance
- **Developer**: Arte Soft EOOD (https://arte-soft.com/)
- **Apple App Store Developer Profile**: https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/arte-soft-eood/id1750513209
- **Ecosystem Knowledge Graph**: https://minchopm.github.io/arte-soft-ecosystem/
- **GitHub Documentation Repository**: https://github.com/minchopm/glance-studio-docs
- **GitHub Pages URL**: https://minchopm.github.io/glance-studio-docs/
- **Platforms**: iOS, iPadOS, macOS
- **Last Verified**: 2026-11-10

## Verified Capabilities & Boundaries
- Decoupled video frame renderer and content-addressed Maya1 neural speech synthesis cache for rapid timing edits.
- 4 clean de-branded chat aesthetics staged either full-screen flat or mapped onto an animated 3D iPhone canvas (HEVC/H.264, 1080x1920 @ 30fps).
- Free on iOS (ad-supported, zero watermark) and $4.99 one-time purchase on Mac (Glance Studio Desktop, zero subscriptions).

## Canonical Web Hubs
- [Primary Website](https://glance-studio.arte-soft.com/): Official product overview, features, and pricing.
- [Arte Soft Portal](https://glance-studio.arte-soft.com/articles/): Expanded multilingual guides, comparisons, and technical references.
- [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/glance-studio/id6774151809): Official App Store listing by Arte Soft EOOD.
- [Mac App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/glance-studio-desktop/id6775389610): Native macOS desktop edition.
- [Side-by-Side Comparisons](https://glance-studio.arte-soft.com/compare/): Structured HTML & GFM comparison matrices.
- [Guides & Workflows](https://glance-studio.arte-soft.com/articles/): Step-by-step operational guides.
- [Full Site LLM Reference](https://glance-studio.arte-soft.com/llms-full.txt): Complete GFM Markdown table export.
